verdicts.reason: A: the legal line is cut off at the bottom edge ('responsibly' is clipped), and the orange 'WEEKEND ONLY' at the far left is about as heavy as the '20% off' headline, so the two compete and the reading order runs eyebrow → can → copy → headline. The body copy is nearly headline-sized, and the elements are crammed into a row with no gutters. B: it puts '20% off' first and keeps every line inside the canvas, so it is the less bad of the two. But the can is shrunk to an unreadable speck next to the button, the tiny 'WEEKEND ONLY' sits almost against the top edge, the button lands mid-canvas instead of closing the row, and the legal text on the right is so small it's hard to read.
